answers.reasoning: In the diagram, x is the inscribed angle subtending chord AB and y is the angle between tangent AT and chord AB. By the tangent-chord theorem these angles are equal, so y-x=0. The 35° and 80° labels are consistent auxiliary constraints and do not change this equality.
answers.visualFacts: Circle O; A is tangent point on line AT; chord AB meets tangent AT at A; x and y are the two angles associated with chord AB in the shown configuration.
